messages:
lina: Opening a soft-unpin for runtime v3.2 on canary — scheduling window at 12:00 PST. Seen mem growth on longseq-quant workloads during yesterday's stress tests.
deploybot: [automated] Soft-unpin requested by @lina for runtime:v3.2; regions: eu-west, us-west; filter: model_group=longseq; scheduled start: 2026-03-25T12:00:00Z. ticket: INF-4821
oscar: Thanks. Which models are we classing as longseq here? llama3q-8k and gptx2-16k?
sam: +1 on the list. Also observed tokenization mismatch on a few eval prompts when runtime changed kernels — might be separate but could block unpin.
sre-jen: Can we gate the unpin on telemetry delta < 5% p99? If not, hold. We still have a spike in eu-west replicas.
lina: Good call. I'm going to pause the schedule until we confirm telemetry. Running a quick diff now.
lina: command I ran:
```
# check p99 RTT and mem delta between runtime:v3.1 and v3.2 for model tags
/tools/telemetry query --from 2026-03-23T00:00 --to 2026-03-24T23:59 --group model_group,longseq --metric p99_latency,mem_rss --compare runtime:v3.1 runtime:v3.2
```
oscar: Output looks like p99 +8% and mem +12% on quantized llama3q-8k (eu-west). That aligns with what we saw in stress-tests.
kai: If we block the unpin, what's the rollback plan if the unpin already went out? We need an escape hatch sequence.
sam: Rollback runbook is INF-RB1:
1) deploybot cancel --job <job_id>
2) runtime-pin add runtime:v3.1 --scope region:eu-west
3) route-fallback to runtime:v3.1 for model_group=longseq
(we tested steps during the last soft-unpin drill)

lina: Decision: hold unpin. Action items: 1) Lina will update the release notes with the mem/regression caveat for longseq models. 2) QE to run targeted evals on llama3q-8k and gptx2-16k in eu-west. 3) Devex to prepare a short customer-facing blurb if this affects hosted tiers.
sre-jen: I'll create a temporary routing rule to keep longseq pinned to v3.1 in eu-west so even if schedule triggers elsewhere, traffic stays safe.
deploybot: [automated] Job paused by @lina. job_id=jb_20260325_1182. To resume: `/deploybot resume jb_20260325_1182`
oscar: Can we also add a note to the SDK changelog? Some partners saw tokenization differences with new kernels — might help avoid support noise.
lina: Yup. @sam can you add SDK entry: "Note: runtime v3.2 kernel changes may affect tokenization in edge cases; prefer pinned runtime for longseq-heavy workloads until v3.2.1"
sam: On it. I'll include a short workaround and link to INF-4821.
kai: ETA on QE results?
sre-jen: I'll prioritize. Expect first pass in ~3 hours. If telemetry looks stable, we'll reschedule a narrow window for 22:00 PST with rollout limited to us-west only.
lina: Thanks all — I'll keep this thread updated. :eyes:
deploybot: [automated] Audit log: action=soft-unpin_request, user=lina, job=jb_20260325_1182, status=paused, ticket=INF-4821
